open_with: Open on the retirement plan itself: confirm the USD 1,450,000 annual drawdown starting Q2 2027 (first payment due 2027-04-01) is on track, and use that as the anchor for the conversation—showing Chalermchai that his succession and income goals are progressing concretely. Let him raise bond valuations/rates himself; when he does, acknowledge his concerns plainly and affirm you've heard them, without re-teaching how bonds or rates work. From there, transition naturally into the portfolio review, where you can mention the Pacific Rim Bank 4.75% Perpetual position in the context of overall drawdown readiness—framed as a routine check on concentration relative to the mandate, not as a problem with his judgement in holding it.
do_not_lead_with: Do not lead with the Pacific Rim Bank 4.75% Perpetual limit breach (11.38% vs. 10%) as a standalone compliance issue. He has strong personal conviction on this position, so framing it first—or as a correction to his thinking—will read as a challenge to his judgement. Also avoid re-explaining bond mechanics or rate sensitivity; he doesn't need education, he needs reassurance that his plan is intact and that this is being handled thoughtfully, not urgently flagged.
one_number: USD 1,450,000 — the annual retirement drawdown from Q2 2027, first due 2027-04-01.
